text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe pruritus, and abnormal liver function tests; to begin our investigation, have you noticed any changes in your urine color or stool consistency recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

Given your history of ulcerative colitis, sexually active male status, and classic symptoms of fatigue and severe itching, this clinical picture strongly suggests Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). I will now request an antimitochondrial antibody (AMA) test and a liver biopsy to confirm the diagnosis.
